articles.title: England fan fury at FIFA 'hypocrisy' after shipyard worker's submarine flag is banned from World Cup stadiums - while Argentina players dance with 'Falkland's are ours' banner
articles.summary: An England fan has criticized FIFA for perceived double standards at the World Cup after his flag was disallowed, while Argentinian players were permitted to display a political banner claiming the Falkland Islands. The incident reignited controversy over political expressions in international sports, highlighting the long-standing territorial dispute and FIFA's inconsistent enforcement of its rules regarding such displays by national teams.

articles.title: Mission: Impossible 8 Release Date: What We Know So Far
articles.summary: The highly anticipated release date for Mission: Impossible 8, starring Tom Cruise, is currently a major talking point in Hollywood. This newest installment continues the hugely popular action franchise, promising more thrilling espionage and innovative stunts. Fans eagerly await official news on when they can experience Tom Cruise's latest adventure on the big screen, highlighting its significance in the entertainment industry.

articles.title: ¡Que viva el pulque! / Long Live Pulque! by Juan Escalona
articles.summary: Juan Escalona's bilingual book, "¡Que viva el pulque! / Long Live Pulque!", published by NOVO Editorial and designed by e+e, celebrates the traditional drink. Emerging from a collective effort, the publication highlights cultural aspects surrounding pulque, contributing to literature on national heritage and customs through its focus on this significant beverage.

articles.title: Keir Starmer makes farewell trip to Kyiv after more die in Russian drone strikes
articles.summary: UK Labour leader Keir Starmer is in Kyiv for a farewell visit, meeting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky following recent Russian drone strikes. This high-profile diplomatic visit, just days before Starmer is due to hand over a significant leadership role, underscores ongoing international engagement and support for Ukraine amidst persistent security challenges posed by the conflict.

articles.title: 'Life of any citizen is precious': Delhi HC orders daily health monitoring of Sonam Wangchuk
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed daily health check-ups for activist Sonam Wangchuk, who is on an an indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar in the national capital. This judicial intervention ensures his well-being amidst his protest, highlighting the court's role in overseeing significant public agitations. For SSB aspirants, this illustrates the interplay between activism, judiciary, and national law and order.

articles.title: Indonesia, India discuss resilient workforce for digital age
articles.summary: During the BRICS Labor and Employment Ministers' Meeting in Jakarta, Indonesia and India discussed practical strategies for enhancing human resource quality and boosting technological innovation. Both nations focused on preparing their workforces to navigate the digital era effectively, emphasizing bilateral cooperation on skill development and future-proofing employment amidst global technological advancements.

articles.title: Where are the Canadian wildfires currently? Check affected Canada and US cities, smoke forecast and latest updates
articles.summary: Over 830 wildfires are currently raging across Canada, with more than 100 classified as out of control. This extensive fire activity is generating thick smoke, leading to severe air quality alerts across large parts of both Canada and the United States. The situation highlights significant environmental challenges and cross-border impacts.
